items.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021
items.q: I went and got the record and tried to play what Vic Dickinson was playing on “In a Sentimental Mood” and I couldn’t do it.

ctx.x: And I felt like I wanted to go up and help him. Odd feeling. So he had his horns in a duffel bag, huh?

Yeah. And he could fix them. He knew how to fix them and stuff. Rubber bands if the springs weren’t right he’d put rubber bands on them and all kinds of stuff you know. And masking tape. He had all kinds of stuff he’d do but he made it work. So you know, so he took me up to his hotel room. And he put on some records like Vic Dickinson and Trummy Young and people in between New Orleans and Lawrence Brown, people in between J.J. and New Orleans. And then I said, “Oh yeah, I like that, I like that. “But J.J.” he…
Did he play a role in your exploration of the conch shell?
